mapper.select: select count(1) today, count(status='online' or null) online from iot_device

select a.*, idm.name product_name, idt.name product_type_name, idm.code product_code from iot_device a left join iot_product_type idt on a.product_type_id=idt.id left join iot_product idm on a.product_id=idm.id where a.id=#{id}
select a.* from iot_device a where a.product_id=#{productId}

choose.when: select a.* from iot_device a left join iot_device pd on a.pid = pd.id left join iot_product p on a.product_id = p.id left join iot_protocol pl on p.protocol_code = pl.code where a.device_sn=#{deviceSn} and pd.device_sn=#{gatewayDeviceSn} and pl.code=#{protocolCode}
choose.otherwise: select a.* from iot_device a left join iot_product p on a.product_id = p.id left join iot_protocol pl on p.protocol_code = pl.code where a.device_sn=#{deviceSn} and pl.code=#{protocolCode}

mapper.select: select a.uid, a.device_group_id groupId, p.device_type type, a.status, a.device_sn deviceSn , pd.device_sn parentDeviceSn, p.code productCode, pl.code protocolCode, a.status from iot_device a inner join iot_device pd on a.pid = pd.id inner join iot_product p on a.product_id = p.id inner join iot_protocol pl on p.protocol_code = pl.code where a.id=#{id}

select a.uid, a.device_group_id groupId, p.device_type type, a.status, a.device_sn deviceSn , pd.device_sn parentDeviceSn, p.code productCode, pl.code protocolCode, a.status from iot_device a inner join iot_device pd on a.pid = pd.id inner join iot_product p on a.product_id = p.id inner join iot_protocol pl on p.protocol_code = pl.code
a.id in ( #{id} )

select a.uid, a.device_group_id groupId, p.device_type type, a.status, a.device_sn deviceSn , pd.device_sn parentDeviceSn, p.code productCode, pl.code protocolCode, a.status from iot_device a inner join iot_device pd on a.pid = pd.id inner join iot_product p on a.product_id = p.id inner join iot_protocol pl on p.protocol_code = pl.code

select a.uid, a.device_group_id groupId, p.device_type type, a.status, a.device_sn deviceSn , pd.device_sn parentDeviceSn, p.code productCode, pl.code protocolCode, a.status from iot_device a inner join iot_device pd on a.pid = pd.id inner join iot_product p on a.product_id = p.id inner join iot_protocol pl on p.protocol_code = pl.code where pl.code=#{protocolCode} and a.device_sn=#{deviceSn}
and pd.device_sn = #{parentDeviceSn}
